protocol.first_attempt: greedy, no feedback, identical for all arms and seeds
protocol.selection: stop on visible-oracle success, uncertainty or infrastructure failure
protocol.hidden_oracle: full function boundaries, used only after final selection
protocol.data_scope: retrospective v2 test plus fresh literals with the same exposed phrases
protocol.supervision: gold IR only for failed-attempt attribution, never for generation or acceptance

interpretation: Decoding seeds share trained checkpoints; intervals describe search randomness, not training uncertainty. Observed gains are search, not learning.
